$comment: Build dependencies (vcpkg manifest mode). README.md, Setup. sdl2: X11 and Wayland video (SDL picks; runtime/src/app/sdl_gl.cpp creates the GLES contexts through EGL on either). Both backends load their system libraries at run time; building the wayland feature needs libwayland-dev (wayland-scanner from libwayland-bin), libxkbcommon-dev and libegl-dev, and uses libdecor-0-dev when present (SDL bundles the protocol XML: no wayland-protocols package). boost-icl + boost-variant: the Boost headers dynarmic includes (boost-headers is only the umbrella CMake package). egl-registry / opengl-registry: headers only; libEGL / libGLESv2 come from the system (Mesa). dynarmic, IJG libjpeg 9b and zstd 1.3.4 (the game's versions; vcpkg's zstd is newer) are not in vcpkg: CMake FetchContent (cmake/deps.cmake). The Windows runner's GLES (port/PLAN.md 5b): ANGLE, feature "angle" (scripts/build.sh --windows turns it on). sqlite3 is pinned to 3.45.1 (overrides), the version of Ubuntu 24.04's libsqlite3 the server used before vcpkg: the served master (server/src/cdn/served_master.cpp make_served_master: a VACUUMed copy) is byte-for-byte that SQLite's output, its SHA-1 feeds the CDN's version ids, and a pre-downloaded phone (SOA_PHONE) only skips the data check while those ids match. Its compile options are Ubuntu's too (cmake/vcpkg-triplets/x64-linux.cmake: SQLITE_SECURE_DELETE zeroes freed space in the VACUUMed file). freetype (zlib only: the default features pull brotli, bzip2 and libpng): the runtime's on-screen text-entry box (runtime/src/app/text_overlay.cpp) draws with Noto Sans JP, built into the programs (cmake/fonts.cmake, common/include/soa/fonts.h; no system font). litehtml (+ gumbo; our overlay port cmake/vcpkg-ports/litehtml, from the Dragalia Lost project: four patches) and stb (stb_truetype, stb_image, stb_image_write; headers): the web view's page renderer (webview/, docs/webview.md). minizip-ng (zlib only: the default features pull bzip2, liblzma, zstd and, for WinZip AES, openssl): the ZIP reader soa_zip (common/src/zip.cpp: APKs, ZIP64 data zips, and archives nested in an archive, read in place through a stream over the mapped file). stb_image_write also writes every other PNG (common/src/png.cpp, soa_codec: the runtime's screenshots, tools/aif2png). pugixml: SharedPreferences XML (common/src/prefs_xml.cpp, soa_codec: the runtime's prefs, the server's Game.xml). msgpack (msgpack-cxx, header-only, without Boost): the server's MessagePack codec (server/src/core/msgpack.cpp). cpp-httplib (header-only; no default features: no brotli / zlib, so no content coding happens behind the server's back): soa-server's HTTP server and client (server/net/http_server.cpp, client.cpp). ffmpeg (FFmpeg's libraries, LGPL-2.1-or-later: no gpl / nonfree / version3 feature; only avcodec, avformat and swresample, so no ffmpeg program, avfilter, avdevice or swscale): the movie player (runtime/src/frontend/movie_decoder.cpp: demuxing the MP4s in place, H.264 and AAC decoding, the audio to 48 kHz float stereo; the YUV to RGB conversion is a shader, frontend/movie.cpp). Its build needs nasm on Linux (README.md, Setup). cli11 (vcpkg builds it precompiled, a static library; CLI11::CLI11 through soa_env): the programs' command lines (common/include/soa/cli.h; the option groups shared by several programs in runtime/include/soaruntime/app/cli.h, platform370/include/platform370/cli.h, server/include/soaserver/cli.h; tests/cli). nlohmann-json (header-only): the English art recipes the server reads (standin-assets-en/recipes/*.json, server/src/english_art/) and soa-server's bridge JSON (server/net/game.cpp). utf8proc (MIT, small): Unicode normalization (NFKC / NFKD / NFC) and character categories for the server's derivation of the English text from Global's master (server/src/master/english_derive.cpp), which must equal tools/english_core.py's unicodedata.
